extruders.machine_end_gcode:
M104 S0 ;Turn off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn off bed
G91 ;Relative positioning
G1 Z10 ;Raise Z
G90 ;Absolute positioning
G1 X0 Y{machine_depth} ;Present print
M84 ;Disable steppers
extruders.machine_start_gcode:
M140 S{material_bed_temperature} ;Heat bed
M104 S{material_print_temperature} ;Heat hotend
G28 ;Home
M190 S{material_bed_temperature} ;Wait for bed
M109 S{material_print_temperature} ;Wait for hotend
G92 E0 ;Reset extruder
